attempts.raw: {"risk": 3, "reason": "The previous null-check on the URL helper (which skipped URL regeneration entirely when no HttpContext was available, e.g. during setup or CLI-driven recipe execution) is removed, so the new unconditional call to LinkGenerator.GetPathByAction with a possibly-null HttpContext could throw or fail for workflow recipes imported outside an HTTP request."}

reason: The previous null-check on the URL helper (which skipped URL regeneration entirely when no HttpContext was available, e.g. during setup or CLI-driven recipe execution) is removed, so the new unconditional call to LinkGenerator.GetPathByAction with a possibly-null HttpContext could throw or fail for workflow recipes imported outside an HTTP request.
